messages:
Chris: Quick exec weekly TL;DR: Private GA timeline steady, tightening SLA targets for Dedicated, and a short runtime cache incident to close out. High-level asks below. :rocket:

Leila: noted. Can you confirm the exact SLA percentiles and rollup interval you want displayed?

Chris: targeting 99.95% availability for Dedicated GA measured monthly; SLO alerting on 5m rollups. Also require p95 per-route latency SLOs.

Sam: product update launch plan is drafted. Canary cohorts + feature flags included. Rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h if metrics stable. Need explicit rollback hooks.

Ravi: incident summary (cache corruption, 04/02): probable root cause is a KV cache eviction race when mixed quantized kernels hit a size boundary. Impact: brief spike of 500s on inference path, mostly Dedicated queues. Draft PM noted: https://redwood.internal/pm/41395-cache-evict (WIP). Proposed fix: add KV lock + integrity check in runtime and a short-term mitigation to throttle affected kernels. ETA for patch + canary ~36h.

Leila: I'll own the runtime patch canary, add integrity checks, and update the runbook. Scheduling 30m sync with Ravi in 30m.

Sam: adding rollback triggers: if canary p50 latency > baseline +30% OR error rate >0.5% for 10m then rollback. Also manual cutoff for cost spikes. Example rollback API: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/rollout -d '{"canary":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'`

ops-bot: deploy pipeline notification: private-ga/canary-2026-05-10 started  2/5 nodes healthy, health-checks running.

Chris: two exec asks: (1) Leila, ensure Console dashboards reflect new SLA and token-cost units by EOD Friday; (2) Sam, publish canary + rollback doc before canary moves to 25%. Escalate to me if blockers. :thumbsup:

Maya: sales note: enterprise prospect asks for per-tenant noise/isolation guarantees for Dedicated and written wording on isolation + SLA. Recommend a one-page FAQ for GA.

Chris: Sam/Leila please prioritize a one-pager for sales/legal. I'll add to Friday exec agenda and follow up on PM link. Short sync Friday 09:30 PT for go/no-go.

Leila: ack.

Ravi: ack, posting postmortem draft in ~1h.

Sam: ack, publishing canary doc and FAQ draft today.

Chris: end.
